asr.normalization: NFC, then remove Unicode P* punctuation and all Python isspace characters; no other rewrites

speaker_attribution.limitation: Exploratory utterance-label agreement only. The protocol defines no speaker metric/collar; this does not measure frame-level DER, boundary accuracy, overlapping speech recall, or missed speech.

limitations: Envelope is temporal extent, not a word/speech coverage rate; silence is not dropped work.
Frozen reference timing and ASR timing differ, so utterance matching does not certify exact boundaries.

Temporal resolvability is not semantic correctness.
